shots.purpose: Launch the scene as Fuzzby’s self-appointed parade already in motion: funny because his importance is faster than his steering.
shots.performanceAssignment: Fuzzby’s chest and chin lead like he is announcing a parade before his eyes have chosen a route. His wings commit too hard, so every dodge becomes an overcorrection: a shoulder clips one stem, the stem whips back into nearby petals, pollen clings to him, and his attempt to shake it off only throws him into the next near-miss. He refuses to acknowledge any of it until the final pop-back, where he arrests himself in a strained official hover, the body still dusted in evidence. Lip-sync the approved @Audio1 performance exactly; no additional speech.
shots.camera: The camera follows and struggles to keep up with Fuzzby, briefly losing him behind stems and pollen bursts; Zenny remains readable in depth as the calm measure he keeps orbiting past.
shots.openingPose: Bee-height between towering flower stems, Fuzzby already slanting hard across the frame with pollen streaming from his path; Zenny is deeper among the flowers, level and undisturbed over her own work.
shots.cutInMotivation: Cutting to Zenny’s steadier frame is stronger than staying in the chase because remaining continuous would trap us inside Fuzzby’s self-image; the comedy needs his chaos measured against competence, not merely extended.
shots.dialogueBinding: Fuzzby's vocal beat performs per the approved voice design.
shots.visualPayoff: Fuzzby reappears, dusted by the task he meant to command, while pollen hangs behind him like failed parade confetti. Lip-sync the approved @Audio1 performance exactly; no additional speech.
prohibited: Lip-sync the approved @Audio1 exactly; no added, dropped, native-generated, or reworded speech.
Opening frame must already have Fuzzby in committed travel, not hovering at rest.
Keep Zenny readable in depth as the steady contrast while Fuzzby’s pollen contacts and overcorrections drive the action.

shots.dialogueTimingProse: Fuzzby’s chant begins after the first committed wingbeat, locked to the dodge-hit-recover rhythm and smearing into the mishap. “Nailed it.” lands only after the pop-back and miniature held pose, followed by a short beat where drifting pollen or wobble answers the cover-up.
shots.referenceRolesProse: Fuzzby and Zenny character references anchor identity and performance scale; the rainforest flower scene look anchors towering stems, pollen, warm natural light, and bee-scale depth; approved @Audio1 anchors all lip-sync and speech timing.
shots.principalPerformanceApproved: Fuzzby drives the chant as exertion and self-hype — “BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…” — then covers an obvious mishap with “Nailed it.” as if saying it can restore authority. Zenny stays absorbed in her precise gathering, not yet granting him the stage.
shots.animationTimingApproved: Keep the chant on quick, effortful wingbeats: short accelerations, tiny panic-corrections, and no graceful glide. Contacts read in crisp cause-and-effect bursts — hit, spring-back, pollen bloom — with Fuzzby always recovering a fraction late. On “Nailed it.” give him a miniature held pose, just long enough for pride to appear, then let one last pollen drift or body wobble betray the cover-up.

output.audienceRead: The opening frame reads instantly as Fuzzby’s overconfident parade already in motion and already unstable, with Zenny calm and readable deeper in the flowers as the steady contrast.
output.composition: Bee-height opening keyframe among tall flower stems. Fuzzby is the dominant foreground subject, slanting hard diagonally across the frame in committed travel, not hovering at rest, with pollen streaming behind his path. Nearby stems and petals partially cross the foreground to suggest the camera is barely keeping up. Zenny remains smaller but clear in the background depth, level and undisturbed over her own work.
output.lensAndCameraRelationship: Low bee-height tracking-camera feel, close to Fuzzby with a moderately wide animated-feature lens relationship so the foreground stems feel large and near while Zenny remains readable in depth. Slight motion blur only on Fuzzby’s wings and pollen trail; character face and body silhouette remain readable.
output.lightingAndDepth: Use @图3 for warm natural sunlight, flower-field palette, material feel, pollen haze and depth atmosphere. Foreground Fuzzby catches warm rim and soft fill; Zenny sits in softer depth light, separated by flower stems and shallow atmospheric depth without losing readability.

output.sceneIntention: Open on Fuzzby already in motion, selling himself as a grand parade leader while his body proves he is barely steering. The voice should ride the wingbeat chaos with buoyant self-importance, then land a tiny cover-up after the pop-back as pollen and wobble expose the truth.

lines.speaker: Fuzzby
lines.dramaticIntention: Fuzzby is hyping his own competence in real time, as if saying the busy chant loudly enough will make the flight look intentional.
lines.subtext: Everyone should be impressed by how official and in control I am; please do not notice I am ricocheting through flowers.
lines.cadenceAndBreath: Fast, bright, effortful bursts locked to wingbeats. Keep each “BIZZY” clipped and forward-driving, with a slight breathless push; the comma is a tiny dodge-correction, not a relaxed pause. Let the trailing ellipsis smear into the mishap rather than resolve cleanly.
lines.timingAndBody: Begin just after the first committed wingbeat, not before the action. Track the dodge-hit-recover rhythm: confidence on the launch, little panic spikes through stem clips and pollen bursts, then carry the last sound into the messy overcorrection while Fuzzby refuses to acknowledge trouble.

lines.speaker: Fuzzby
lines.dramaticIntention: Fuzzby attempts to restore authority with a small official declaration after an obviously chaotic recovery.
lines.subtext: If I say this calmly, maybe the evidence on my body stops counting.
lines.cadenceAndBreath: One quick recovery breath, then a compact, proud, slightly strained “Nailed it.” Keep it dry and self-certifying, not broadly triumphant; the strain should leak through the polish.
lines.timingAndBody: Land only after the pop-back into the held hover. Hold the final period with false certainty, then leave a short silent beat for drifting pollen or a body wobble to contradict him.
